comments.story: Jack Ma's Ant Group set for record $34B market debut
comments.text: I'm more skeptical after seeing this: [VIDEO] I would have expected being a party member to just be the default in order for anyone to do anything of substance in China, but he comes across extremely poorly in that interview. So poorly, that I find it more likely that the companies are being propped up/operated by the government than someone like him could successfully build/run them.
